common.effect: Effect on the chart of accounts

todo.claimCollect: Record the collection of {no} and issue the receipt

collect.title: Deal closed · collect commission {code}
collect.subNew: {company} · {commission} · an account was opened under Clients

accountForm.title: New account in the chart
accountForm.name: Account name
accountForm.note: The code is generated from the parent account's code. If you enter an opening balance, a balanced journal entry is posted automatically.

tree.loadFailed: Couldn't load the chart of accounts
tree.note: The five main accounts are fixed. You can add a sub-account under any account, and an opening balance posts its own journal entry. Every voucher or entry shows here right away.

opening.title: Opening balances
opening.note: Enter each account's balance on the start day, each in its own direction (assets debit, liabilities credit). The difference closes to retained earnings (33) in a single entry.

bills.payNote: Fixed bill {name} · due on day {day} · usual amount {amount} (edit it if the invoice differs)
bills.skipWhy: Why won't it be paid this month?
bills.dueSub: Nothing is paid automatically · you approve and pay, or postpone this month
bills.added: Added · you'll get a task on its due day
bills.note: A fixed bill (subscription, rent, internet…) is never paid automatically: on its due day you get a notification and a card in «Safes & moves», and you approve and pay (a payment voucher with its entry) or choose «Not this month».

budget.added: Line added and its account opened in the chart
budget.withBudget: {count, plural, one {# line with a budget} other {# lines with a budget}}
budget.note: A budget for each expense line in the chart. «Spent» = the account's moves in the line's period (click it for details). When a line reaches its alert % or goes over budget, the accountant and the owner get a notification.
budget.name: Line name

cash.note: Every voucher posts its own journal entry and updates the chart's balances right away. No payment can exceed the safe's balance. Click any safe to see its statement.

claims.issued: Claim generated from the template · stamped and signed
claims.clientApprovedOk: Finance notified to upload the e-invoice
claims.note: Sales requests the claim from the deal (company · unit details · amount) → «Approve & issue claim» generates it from the template, stamped and signed → sales sends it to the client and marks «Client approved» → you upload the e-invoice and enter its number → when the client pays, «Collected · issue receipt» creates a receive voucher for the amount, and the «cash receipt» is generated from the same details.
claims.receiptAsked: Client paid and asked for a receipt
claims.einvoiceNote: Upload it on the e-invoice portal and enter its number here.
claims.collectNote: After saving, the «cash receipt» is generated from the claim's details.

commissions.title: Sales commissions
commissions.sub: Paid per deal against its TCR · from Sales commission (21103) to the safe
commissions.empty: No commissions yet · they become due once the deal is fully collected
commissions.note: A commission becomes due once the deal is fully collected, and shows in the salesperson's account under «Sales commission due» (21103). Click a commission to see its statement deal by deal; «Pay» creates a «Sales commission payment» voucher with its entry.
commissions.formula: Commission = the salesperson's rate (the Scheme) × their share of the deal (Buyer or Seller) × Places' commission; it becomes due once the deal is fully collected.
commissions.tlLead: Team Leader commission (on the team's achievement, not a deal):
commissions.tlNote: Team Leader commission: on the team's achievement, not a deal · due
commissions.saved: Commission paid · the salesperson was notified

cost.byChannelTitle: Marketing cost of deals · by platform
cost.emptyChannels: No collected deals with these filters
cost.note: A deal's marketing cost = the spend of the campaign that brought the lead ÷ the number of Qualified leads it brought. Commission = sales commission on what was collected + operations commission + external commission. In the accounts (income statement) the campaign stays at its full amount.
cost.ratesSub: Of Places' commission, posted with the deal's first collection · an external commission entered in the deal review overrides the rate

custody.note: A custody or an advance is a payment voucher to a person. Each person has their own account in the chart (custody under 134, advances under 131), opened with the first move. Settlement: how much was spent and on which line, and how much cash came back and to which safe.
custody.advancesSub: An advance statement per employee · the salary deduction runs with payroll

dash.payrollSub: {count, plural, one {# employee} other {# employees}} · net {net} · all at once
dash.wfSub: In stages, as Dr. Ali calculates it · same figures as the income statement

journal.note: Every voucher posts its own entry; a manual entry is made from «New journal entry» (debit = credit). Total debit {debit} · total credit {credit}

move.saved: Recorded · the journal entry was posted automatically
move.expenseType: Expense type (from the chart of accounts)
move.recipientPlaceholder: Name of the person receiving the money

payroll.paid: Payroll paid · every employee was notified of their net salary
payroll.notPaidSub: Paid all at once: salary − attendance deduction − the advance deduction you chose
payroll.salariesSub: {count, plural, one {# employee} other {# employees}} · base
payroll.empty: No salaries recorded yet · HR enters each employee's salary from their file in «HR».
payroll.deductionsApproved: Deductions were approved by HR and posted. Salaries after deductions are charged to expenses automatically.
payroll.deductionsPending: This month's deductions are still waiting for HR approval, so they aren't counted here.
payroll.commissionsNote: Commissions aren't here: they're paid per deal against its TCR. The default advance deduction = everything owed, and next month starts with your same choice.
payroll.payNote: All salaries at once. The system creates one «Payroll payment» voucher with its entry, and every employee gets a notification with their net salary.

pnl.monthHint: Only what happened this month (vouchers and entries by their date)
pnl.yearHint: From the start of the year until today
pnl.clickHint: Click any figure to see how it was reached and what it feeds into

path.rev: Revenue → Deals profit → Operating profit → Net profit
path.dir: Direct expenses → Deals profit → Operating profit → Net profit
path.sel: Selling expenses → Operating profit → Net profit
path.gross: Deals profit → Operating profit → Net profit
path.net: = A/C 34 «Profit and loss for the year»

pnl.note: The income statement every month, the balance sheet every 3 months, and net profit at any time. The figures here are the chart of accounts' own balances, so every voucher or entry shows here right away. Net profit for the year to date = A/C 34.

bs.hint: Balance sheet · from the chart of accounts · open any item to see its sub-accounts, and click any account to see where its balance came from
